propositions: The typecheck target in Makefile only runs mypy over src/rebar, leaving 47 Python files in scripts/ type-unchecked despite being lint-clean and used by CI gates
Widening typecheck to include scripts/ surfaces 15 fixable mypy errors across 6 scripts files, including 2 latent bugs (str|None.strip() call and None dict passed where dict[str,int] required)
After fixing all 15 errors at source with real type annotations, no per-module mypy override or new type: ignore comment is needed
The sys.path bootstrap pattern used by 9 scripts files is already accommodated by existing myproject.toml config (follow_imports=silent, ignore_missing_imports=true) and produces no import errors
Stale type-gate scope descriptions in .pre-commit-config.yaml and .github/workflows/_build-and-test.yml claim full src/rebar coverage and must be corrected to reflect the widened scope
